automated.summary: Fourteen required leaves verified individually by the vitest discriminator - present AND NOT skipped AND NOT failed - not by name, which proves nothing for vitest. The negative control confirmed the discriminator: a -t filter matching nothing still lists all 12 testcases under their real names, every one skipped. verify.py passes. The shipped ask-period-control leaf passes UNMODIFIED, which is criterion 8 - had the failure policy leaked instead of being stated by the caller, it would have needed editing. The only edit to ask-panel.test.tsx is the one authorized under signal S-0018-93e2: its harness reruns the SAME selection as the turn it just created, so the matched rerun now correctly sends that turn's own question; toHaveBeenNthCalledWith is retained, so it still proves the selection is sent rather than being loosened to toHaveBeenCalled().
